title: main-tree reviewer fingerprint can move mid-review if a reviewer emits un-ignored test outputs (coverage.xml, junit.xml, htmlcov/, .hypothesis/)
detail: Regression-sentinel review of verdict-hash-main-tree (2026-10-25): with v0.224 the main-tree fingerprint covers git tracked + untracked-not-ignored files. git check-ignore shows coverage.xml, junit.xml, htmlcov/ and .hypothesis/ are NOT ignored in either design-partner repo or the engine (one partner also leaves test-results/ playwright-report/ un-ignored, the other .eslintcache). Today nobody emits them (zero untracked non-ignored files observed), but a reviewer adding --cov-report=xml|html or --junitxml would move the fingerprint mid-review and stale a co-reviewer (the parallel-reviewer race class, fb-92e248d6a208). Options: prune well-known derived test outputs in main-tree mode, or have prusik init/doctor add/flag them in .gitignore, or document the requirement in the reviewer role templates.
